Thanks for the demo last week. Legal and Security here at Paragon are working through the DPA and the UK IDTA / addendum language. Two asks from our side before procurement will move forward: 

1) Evidence set for TIA/DTIA scope — Paragon needs a short inventory of the concrete artifacts you can provide to prove residency and controls for UK processing (logs, KV-cache evidence, audit sampling). We understand some items are operational, but a clear checklist will help us close internally.

Forwarded message: see thread above. Technical notes for the KV-cache sample and mitigations.

Hi all — quick operations checklist and constraints so expectations are aligned: 

1) KV-cache sample contents: will include timestamps, cache keys (hashed), approximate object size, and region-edge node identifier. We will redact content and any direct PHI identifiers prior to export. Expected output: CSV with 7 days of events — we can supply within 24-48 hours after scope confirmation. Example stub attached (kv-cache-audit-sample.csv).

2) Residency proof: we will include a routing snapshot (config dump) showing that traffic for Paragon's tenant ID is pinned to our eu-west-2 region for the configured routes, and the active model-serving pools for the tenant. That config is part of the evidence packet.

3) HSM/KMS details: Redwood uses customer-tenant keys in HSM-backed KMS for dedicated/private deployments. For hosted customers we provide envelope encryption with region-restricted key material; we can provide key rotation logs and KMS tenancy attestations as redacted artifacts.

4) Emergency disclosure handling: operationally, when we receive a legal request we capture a legal log (request metadata, jurisdiction, scope) and run it through the legal review workflow. We will commit to retaining those logs and providing copies to Paragon for audit under NDAs where permitted.

Open items I need from Paragon to run the extraction: (a) tenant ID(s) or example object prefixes to include; (b) preferred sample date window (if none, we'll use last full week); (c) contact for technical on-call during the review call.

If Paragon is comfortable I'll spin up the extraction job Thursday morning and route the output to a secure share.

—Jonas Weber
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference
